verdict.rationale: Measuring model performance and shadow-testing new rules or models is a fair question for an AML screening and transaction-monitoring platform with configurable risk scoring and AI agents, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no precision/recall reporting and no shadow or champion-challenger mode. Case and decision exports, and the option to keep multiple screening configurations, would only let a user compute metrics themselves; that is a user-side workaround and an adjacent feature, so it earns no credit.
